bias.en: Rebound · edging above the 100-day, SAR at $146.6
bias.zh: 反弹 · 小幅站上 100 日均线，SAR 在 $146.6

read.en: SpaceX rose 0.7% on Nov 10 to $143.09, trading $137.65–144.89. It is above the 5-day ($135.8), 10-day ($138.1) and 100-day ($143.0) and below the 30-day ($149.4); all four averages are falling (no 200-day yet, 105 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($146.56), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月10日上涨 0.7%，收于 $143.09，盘中区间 $137.65–144.89。股价位于 5 日（$135.8）、10 日（$138.1）和 100 日（$143.0）均线上方，30 日（$149.4）均线下方；四条均线均在下行（上市仅 105 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线）。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$146.56），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close edged above the 100-day ($143.0) but stayed just under the $143.2 Nov 9 high, and the $144.89 high stopped under the SAR ($146.56). Resistance is $144.9–146.6 (Nov 10 high, SAR), then $149.4–149.8 (30-day, Aug 17 high) and $155. Support is $137.7–143, then $134.5–135.8 (5-day, Oct 30 low) and $130.2–131.9. A close above $146.6 would target $149.4–149.8; below $137.7, $135.

s.en: 100-day average $143.0, reclaimed; Oct 15 low $140.66; 10-day $138.1; Nov 10 low $137.65
Aug 10 and Aug 20 lows ($130.2–130.4); Nov 5 high $131.87
